description: Fork of exp284 (dual-stream, d_v=64, v_tph=512, out_proj partition_sets by head, ffn+skip). Two coupled changes: (1) d_v 64 -> 16 (shrinks v_lut output dim and out_proj input dim 4x); (2) out_partition_by_head FALSE (no partition_sets — at d_v=16 the per-head pool C(16,2)=120 is small and partitioning may be too restrictive). out_proj sees full H*d_v=96 input, anchor pairs sampled from C(96,2)=4560 pool. Param impact: v_lut shrinks 4x in n_outputs (12.58M -> 3.15M per layer; -56.6M total). Total ~204M. Comparator: exp284 last-seen ~step 3800 around 1.79.
